response.sql: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref AS project_reference, p.fundflux AS funding_source, SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.project_reference, pr.funding_source, pr.rate, pr.rate - b.average_rate AS gap_above_benchmark FROM project_rates AS pr CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE pr.rate > b.average_rate ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC LIMIT 10;
